subject: Mutual action plan: Sunline evaluation - security gates & DPA timeline
messages:
From: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@sunline.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual action plan: Sunline evaluation - security gates & DPA timeline

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation, I put together a tight mutual action plan (attached) that sequences the evaluation and the security/compliance gates we discussed. High level:

- Week 1 (this week): handoff to security — provide SOC 2 summary, SIG/CAIQ snapshot, and draft DPA redline.
- Week 2: Sunline security review (questions + clarifications) + technical deep-dive with SE.
- Week 3: Legal/Procurement finalize DPA; decide on deployment mode (Hosted vs Private).
- Week 4: Pilot / limited production run once DPA in place.

Key security items called out in the MAP: SOC 2 Type II evidence (summary attached), SIG/CAIQ completed answers (attached snapshot), proposed DPA redline (see Drive link). Data retention proposal: default 90 days for transient inference data in Hosted; option for 30/90/365-day retention windows or customer-managed retention for Private deployments. We also included an annex describing EU region hosting and KMS options (HSM-backed CIDR for Private).

Attachments: Sunline_MAP_v1.pdf, redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, sig_caiq_snapshot.xlsx

Next steps: can you confirm the right security contact(s) to receive the SOC2 and CAIQ artifacts? Also let us know any mandatory retention limits or escrow/escrow-like requirements your team needs captured in the DPA.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute MAP review next week.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0192

From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@sunline.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@sunline.com, ctech@sunline.com
Date: Sat, 11 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Sunline evaluation - security gates & DPA timeline

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for sending the MAP and the supporting artifacts. Quick clarifying questions from our security and procurement teams before we book a call:

1) Data residency: you mention EU region hosting as an option — can you confirm which Azure/GCP regions you currently operate and whether we can restrict inference and logs to eu-west1 (or equivalent) for the pilot?

2) Data retention: our policy requires that customer-sensitive PII derived from requests be retained no longer than 180 days by default unless an exception is granted. Does Redwood support per-customer retention controls and a self-service TTL, or would that require Redwood Private?

3) Key management: does Redwood support customer-managed keys / HSM for encryption at rest? If yes, is that available on Hosted or only in Private deployments?

4) SOC 2: can we get the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA, or do you only provide the summary by default? Procurement prefers the full report where possible.

5) SIG/CAIQ: what percent complete is your CAIQ, and do you have a control-by-control mapping we can review?

For scheduling, our security lead (copied as security@sunline.com) prefers mornings next week.

Regards,
Alyssa Cheng
Senior Manager, Cloud Risk & Compliance
Sunline Financial
alyssa.cheng@sunline.com

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@sunline.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Mar 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Sunline evaluation - security gates & DPA timeline

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks for the spot questions. Quick technical clarifications below (happy to expand on the call):

- Regions: Redwood Hosted currently operates in us-west1, us-east4, and eu-west1. For the pilot we can pin your environment to eu-west1 so inference and standard operational logs remain in-region.

- Retention: Hosted offers configurable retention windows (30 / 90 / 180 days) for inference metadata and request/response logs. Default is 90 days. For strict per-customer TTL enforcement with KMS key separation we recommend Redwood Private, which supports per-tenant TTLs and hard-delete workflows.

- Key management: Customer-managed keys (CMK) with HSM-backed KMS are available for Redwood Private today. We offer an HSM-backed KMS integration for Dedicated plans (bring-your-own-key pattern via our KMS connector). Hosted customers can opt into CMK in limited regions where KMS integration is available; we'll confirm availability for eu-west1 in the follow-up.

- SOC 2: Priyom attached the SOC 2 summary but we can provide the full Type II under NDA. Laura (cc) handles legal/NDAs and will share the standard SOC 2 NDA flow.

- CAIQ: Attached is a CAIQ snapshot (sig_caiq_snapshot.xlsx) with in-progress answers. Current completion is ~82%; remaining items are specific vendor attestations and an internal control that we will finalize this sprint. We'll identify any high-risk gaps before your security review.

Attachments: redwood_soc2_summary.pdf, sig_caiq_snapshot.xlsx

Note: For the DPA redline, Laura will work with your procurement/legal team. We can accommodate the 180-day retention as an approved exception in Hosted for the pilot, but we recommend moving to Private for long-term control and key separation.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

From: Alyssa Cheng <alyssa.cheng@sunline.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Mar 2028 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan: Sunline evaluation - security gates & DPA timeline

Priyom / Ben / Laura —

Thanks for the quick responses and the artifacts. We reviewed the materials with our security team today. A few action items from our side:

- Security will accept the SOC 2 summary for the initial technical review; we will request the full Type II under NDA once the pilot looks good.
- Retention: Sunline is prepared to accept a 90-day default for the pilot, but procurement will mark 180 days as the preferred limit in the final DPA unless otherwise negotiated.
- KMS: we prefer HSM-backed CMKs for production; procurement will signal whether the pilot requires CMK or not.

Next steps: procurement/legal will send one consolidated DPA redline to Laura by Friday. After we get the redline we can lock in the hosting region (eu-west1) and schedule the MAP review call. Can we do Thursday 10:00 AM CET for a 30-minute alignment call?
